title: Review of c22's metabolic crawler: rim uptake replicates on fresh seeds 3-4 and, run to t=40, the cut-twin size gap closes from 0.81 to 0.13 (common size ~1.85-1.9); whole-body synthesis keeps a 0.69 gap
summary: Author's branch script on fresh seeds to t=40 plus a labkit run of the cut world. With rim uptake the front-cut cell re-polarizes within ~3 t, crawls at 0.39 vs 0.40, grows 1.58 -> 1.81 while its twin shrinks 2.40 -> 1.94 on both seeds (gap 0.81 -> 0.13), still converging at t=40. With whole-body synthesis (seed 3) both shrink in parallel and the gap stays 0.69. Supported; part of the closing is the twin's own descent.

observations.R: cuts/met3_s3/cut.png and met3_s4: cut cell re-polarizes and regrows 1.58 -> 1.81 while the twin shrinks to 1.94 (gap 0.13 at t=40); cuts/met2_s3: whole-body synthesis keeps a 0.69 gap

controls_run.R: branched undamaged twins in cuts/*/track_twin.txt; whole-body synthesis arm cuts/met2_s3 as the matched contrast

verdicts.limitation: Planted crawler; one parameter set per arm; twins still shrinking at t=40 (nutrient not at steady state), so the set point is approached, not reached; part of the gap closing is the twin's descent; the nutrient dependence is by construction.
